assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: Original fictional Korean design-agency portfolio presentation plate. Deliver an opaque fullbleed portrait 4:5 image, preferably 1536x1920, for display at 720x900. This is a finished bitmap portfolio composition of real designed deliverables, never a website screenshot.
Style: polished contemporary Korean agency art direction; realistic package/paper/product photography, believable shadows, deliberate hierarchy. At only350px width the main subject and headline must remain clear. Essential text and meaningful design within6% inset. No outer frame around whole image, no watermark, no external brand logo, no gibberish or tiny filler copy. Fonts: Montserrat-like graphic English, Pretendard-like Korean; typography near-black #090A0F or white #FFFFFF. Do not show actual clients, testimonials, performance metrics, certifications or awards. The pictured brand and project are fictional concepts.
Primary request: Create a compelling brand/campaign portfolio image for fictional neighborhood bakery/cafe '모닝오븐' / 'MORNING OVEN', whose customers need to remember the new shop and feel invited to visit for freshly baked menu items.
Composition: Limit to THREE designed deliverables, 1) a finished large photo-led poster, 2) a coordinated folded bakery takeaway bag, and3) a paper coffee cup with sleeve. The poster dominates the upper/left, almost front-on so design is clear; tactile bag and cup arranged partly infront/beside it without obscuring headline or food. Large appetizing salted butter bread torn to reveal warm textured crumb on the poster, gorgeous realistic baked golden crust, not a surreal sculpture. Energetic smart layout with coherent brand identity and one original simple baking graphic repeated on package.
Palette: bright tomato-red with white/cream, small buttery-yellow accent; premium yet approachable Korean neighborhood bakery, avoid generic luxury beige minimalism.
Text: Large elegant Korean poster headline EXACTLY '오늘도 갓 구운 행복', can break naturally across two lines. Brand EXACTLY '모닝오븐'. Secondary brand 'MORNING OVEN' on bag/cup if useful. Only other text allowed is small readable 'BAKERY & COFFEE'. All Korean must be clean and correct; no invented extra tiny copy. 4:5 fullbleed.
